causal_observation: Candidate parent frame 20 and frame 30 only, both before first collision. Frame 30 is 0.6 s; no later collision, actor reward, seed or lane feature. Thirteen features: ball/root relative x and y; ball vx; root vx/vy; four body-ball distances (two ankles, two knees); two ankle heights; two knee-ball closing speeds from frames 20..30.
label: New harm of 1.2 relative to 0.8: originally clean foot becomes nonfoot or originally <=4m ball excursion becomes >4m.
models: standardized logistic regression C=0.1 class_weight={0:1,1:4} max_iter=1000 random_state=0
random forest 200 trees max_depth=4 min_samples_leaf=2 class_weight={0:1,1:4} random_state=0
validation: Leave-one-seed-out on all 81 consumed paired courses; report probability thresholds 0.2 and 0.5 with risk recall, safe vetoes and selected high-quality. Threshold comparison consumes this development bank and requires a new independent physical test. A frame-30 prediction does not prove a switch from 1.2 to 0.8 is physically safe.
gate: No model/motor export if any held-out risk missed or if frame 30 is not strictly precontact. A passing offline model only authorizes a separate SIM_ONLY switched-control physical experiment.
